name: Ajatashatru
source:
A former subordinate of Ashoka, and a central figure in the Indian Civil War.

Dreams of becoming more like Ashoka when she gets all super-pissed.

”You’re gonna get it next time, bitch! Oops, I mean... Ashoka.”
